title: Actuator discovery must be descriptive and fail closed
summary: Keep discovery separate from execution and provide exact operation contracts alongside compact listings.
reusable_steps: Keep discovery separate from execution and provide exact operation contracts alongside compact listings
expected_outcome: Actuator list, describe, and check discovery operations must never invoke action handlers. Compact operation listings support browsing; authored schemas and examples provide exact parameter requirements for execution. Missing or invalid discovery metadata must fail closed with an actionable diagnostic rather than invoking a handler or presenting an unreliable contract.
